mistake_reason: WebSurfer misinterpreted the Baseball-Reference table by treating Plate Appearances (PA = 667) as At-Bats (AB). The page clearly listed both PA (667) and AB (519), but the agent incorrectly equated PA with AB and reported 667 as the at-bats value. This is a classic Tool Output Misinterpretation (FM-4.2): the agent derived an unsound conclusion despite accurate and unambiguous tool output showing the correct AB value.
